groups.title: Listening · Chép câu nghe được
groups.instructions: 1. You will hear 5 sentences about a birthday party. Listen carefully and write down exactly what you hear. You will hear each sentence twice.
groups.context: You will hear a conversation between a customer named Katherine and a representative from John's Outdoor Center. Katherine is enquiring about booking a venue for her upcoming birthday celebration.

groups.title: Listening · Điền biểu mẫu
groups.instructions:
2. Listen and complete the notes below.
Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.context:
JOHN’S OUTDOOR CENTRE – PARTY ENQUIRY FORM

Event: Katherine’s (1) ____________
Reason for choosing this place: it is (2) ____________ from the city
Katherine’s birthday: (3) ________________________
Overnight accommodation: in the (4) ________________________
Phone number: (5) ________________________

groups.title: Listening · Trả lời ngắn
groups.instructions: 3. Listen to the recording and answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

items.prompt: 6. On what date would Katherine like to celebrate the party?
7. What day of the week will the party be held?
8. What does John’s calendar show about that date?
9. Why are the horses not available for riding on that day?
10. What evening activity will be organised for Katherine’s guests?

groups.title: Vocabulary · Từ trang trọng
groups.instructions: I.  Use more formal alternatives to the words in bold. Make any necessary grammatical changes.

items.prompt: 1. The book is mainly concerned with the problem of policing the internet
2. The work of the Institute is not only devoted to cancer research.
3. We tried to find a new way of understanding the data.
4. Almost every school in the country had reported problems with the new system
5. Basically, we believe we have demonstrated a significant link between the two events.

groups.title: Vocabulary · Biến đổi từ
groups.instructions: II. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in CAPITALS.

items.prompt: 6. Mass tourism has led to the _______________ of many local habitats. (DESTROY)
7. The singer gained _______________ worldwide after releasing her hit song. (RECOGNIZE)
8. Playing sports is a great way to keep yourself _______________ and energetic. (HEALTH)
9. Some locals are very _______________ and always welcome visitors with a smile. (HOSPITALITY)
10. The rapid _______________ of the city has caused significant traffic jams. (DEVELOP)

groups.title: Vocabulary · Cụm từ
groups.instructions: III.  Complete the collocations in the sentences below. Write ONE WORD only for each blank.

items.prompt: 11. The study lacks solid __________ to support its conclusion that radiation caused the problem.
12. Increasing pollution levels pose a __________ to the stability of the local ecosystem.
13. The political motives for the government's actions are beyond the __________ of this essay.
14. The hospital puts a lot of __________ on training nurses to ensure high-quality care.
15. I play sports like football or tennis regularly to keep in __________.
16. Up until the 1980s, actors did not care much about their public __________.
17. International students __________ for nearly 80% of the university's total population.
18. Experts recommend playing sports on a regular __________.

groups.title: Speaking · Trả lời viết
groups.instructions: Viết câu trả lời tối thiểu 50 từ cho mỗi câu hỏi.

items.prompt:
Question 1: In a few words, tell me about a close friend of yours
+ Who is he/she?
+ How did you know each other?
+ What do you have in common?

Question 2: Describe your last holiday
+ When was it?
+ Who did you go with?
+ Did you enjoy it?

Question 3: Tell me about your English studying journey
+ How long have you been studying English?
+ What are the problems you’ve had?
+ What is the most enjoyable part during this journey?
+ How do you often self-study?
